sources.title_en: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.title_original: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.summary: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers. Author Mike Major cautions against jumping to conclusions, however, noting that business cycle shifts and remote work trends could also explain the numbers. The article Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 澳洲央行發現早期跡象顯示，人工智慧正在衝擊高度曝險職位（如軟體開發和客戶服務）的年輕入門員工。自 ChatGPT 推出以來，這些領域中 15 至 24 歲族群的職缺與就業率下降幅度，比年長員工更為劇烈。不過，作家麥克・梅傑（Mike Major）警告切勿妄下定論，並指出景氣迴圈轉變和遠距工作趨勢也可能是這些資料的原因。

sources.summary: Release: datasette-llm 0.1a11 datasette-llm is the intermediate plugin for Datasette that supports configuring LLMs for use with other Datasette plugins. This release adds support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so you can configure Datasette to use an LLM hosted anywhere that talks the OpenAI pseudo-standard web protocol. This means that if you're running local models with LM Studio or Ollama or llama.cpp (which just hit v1.0.0 ) you can run Datasette via uvx like this: And you'll get a local server running a Datasette Agent instance powered by your local model! Tags: uv , datasette-agent , llm , datasette , llms , ai , generative-ai

sources.title: Gemini 4 Carbon 奪得 MathArena 桂冠，但成本比 GPT-6.1 Sol 高出 15 倍 / Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
sources.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 奪得 MathArena 桂冠，但成本比 GPT-6.1 Sol 高出 15 倍
sources.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
sources.title_original: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
sources.summary: For the first time in a while, no OpenAI model leads the MathArena AI math benchmark. Google's Gemini 4 Carbon and Anthropic's Fable 5.2 have knocked GPT-6.1 Sol from the top, though both cost significantly more. Gemini ignored the time limit in testing and almost never gave up on a task. The article Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 這段時間以來首次，沒有 OpenAI 模型在 MathArena AI 數學基準測試中領先。Google's Gemini 4 Carbon 與 Anthropic's Fable 5.2 將 GPT-6.1 Sol 擠下了榜首，儘管兩者的成本高出許多。Gemini 在測試中忽略了時間限制，並且幾乎從不放棄任何任務。

sources.title_zh: 美團發布了一款從未使用過輝達 GPU 的 1.6 兆參數代理模型
sources.title_en: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
sources.title_original: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
sources.summary: Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for AI agents and trained entirely on Chinese hardware. On Terminal Bench, it scores 88.4 points, landing just behind Claude Opus 5. The sample deployment runs on 194 Huawei Ascend chips, and Meituan makes no mention of Nvidia GPUs. The article Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 美團已發布 LongCat-2.5 的權重，這是一款專為 AI 代理打造、擁有 1.6 兆參數的模型，且完全在中國硬體上訓練。在 Terminal Bench 上，它獲得了 88.4 分，僅落後於 Claude Opus 5。範例部署運行在 194 個 華為 昇騰（Ascend）晶片上，且美團未提及輝達（Nvidia）GPU。

sources.summary: Days before what could be the largest IPO in history, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called buying compute 'the deepest business dilemma' his company faces. Anthropic's commitments now total nearly $901 billion, and it's still far from clear whether future revenue will justify those costs. The planned IPO is largely meant to serve as a financial buffer against that uncertainty. items.summary: Days before what could be the largest IPO in history, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called buying compute 'the deepest business dilemma' his company faces. Anthropic's commitments now total nearly $901 billion, and it's still far from clear whether future revenue will justify those costs. The planned IPO is largely meant to serve as a financial buffer against that uncertainty. The article Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.title: 澳洲央行發現人工智慧首當其衝影響年輕員工，特別是在軟體與客戶服務領域 / Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.title_zh: 澳洲央行發現人工智慧首當其衝影響年輕員工，特別是在軟體與客戶服務領域
sources.title_en: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.title_original: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.summary: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers. Author Mike Major cautions against jumping to conclusions, however, noting that business cycle shifts and remote work trends could also explain the numbers. The article Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 澳洲央行發現早期跡象顯示，人工智慧正在衝擊高度曝險職位（如軟體開發和客戶服務）的年輕入門員工。自 ChatGPT 推出以來，這些領域中 15 至 24 歲族群的職缺與就業率下降幅度，比年長員工更為劇烈。不過，作家麥克・梅傑（Mike Major）警告切勿妄下定論，並指出景氣迴圈轉變和遠距工作趨勢也可能是這些資料的原因。

Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU

Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for AI agents and trained entirely on Chinese hardware. On Terminal Bench, it scores 88.4 points, landing just behind Claude Opus 5. The sample deployment runs on 194 Huawei Ascend chips, and Meituan makes no mention of Nvidia GPUs.
